_comment: OSM road network for the raster's AOI. Requires internet access on first run; responses are cached under ~/.cache/terrascope/osm_roads. No ML inference — vector data from OpenStreetMap, confidence=1.0. Run with: uv run terrascope2 --config packages/cli2/examples/job.osm_roads.json

processes.name: osm-roads
processes._comment_classes: Filter by broad class. Omit 'classes' to emit all three: major_road, road, local_road.

kwargs._comment_url: kumi.systems is often faster than the primary overpass-api.de instance.
kwargs._comment_timeout: server_timeout goes into [timeout:N] in the QL; HTTP socket timeout must be larger.
